lookback_notes: No assessor observation/look-back window is stated for this audit area. The protocol states a staleness threshold instead: a medical evaluation document dated more than 12 months prior to the date of service is deemed missing (p. 5). That 12-month figure is a document-age/validity threshold tied to the date of service, not an observation window ending on an assessment reference date, so lookback_days is left NOT_FOUND.

state_deltas.delta: This is a New York State (OMIG) audit protocol for the Assisted Living Program; audit area 5 disallows claims when the medical evaluation is missing or is dated more than 12 months prior to the date of service. Applicable service dates for the protocol are 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.

source.quote: OMIG AUDIT PROTOCOL Assisted Living Program (ALP) (For Service Dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025)
